applicant.organisation: Institute for Labour Law, University of Linz

purpose: We research discrimination against people with diabetes in the labour market, e.g. at job interviews, and need population prevalence to compare with our complaints data.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
